name: The Lessons of Ta'zo
summary: Ta'zo asks you to bring magical works to the library in Ironforge. Each addition helps expand its collection and knowledge.

sections.title: A Library's Collection
sections.body: Ta'zo asks you in the Library of Ironforge to bring something for its collection. Magical works that might benefit the library are welcome, and your efforts help expand its knowledge.

faq.q: Who is asking for magical works?
faq.answer: Ta'zo asks you to bring magical works that might benefit the library in Ironforge.

faq.q: What does Ta'zo want brought to the library?
faq.answer: Ta'zo asks for magical works that might benefit the library's collection.

faq.q: Where does Ta'zo keep the collection?
faq.answer: The collection is in the Library of Ironforge.

faq.q: Why does Ta'zo ask for magical works?
faq.answer: Ta'zo says the library's knowledge expands through your efforts.
